Don’t beep here — there’s a hospital close by.
No beeping here, there’s a hospital next door.

tasks.say: Я за вихідні подивився запоєм увесь новий сезон.
ans: I binge-watched the whole new season over the weekend.
Over the weekend I binge-watched the entire new season.
I binge-watched the whole new season this weekend — no sleep.

ans: I’m lying under a blanket and binge-watching shows.
I’m just binge-watching series under a blanket.
Just binge-watching TV shows under a blanket.

tasks.say: Не починай його в будній день — ти подивишся все за одну ніч.
ans: Don’t start it on a weekday — you’ll binge-watch it all in one night.
Don’t start it on a work night; you’ll end up binge-watching the whole thing.
Don’t start it midweek — you’ll binge-watch it in one night.

near: relax*|rest*|hang out|hanging out|hung out|take it easy|do nothing|doing nothing|lounge*|laze*

Nah, I’m just gonna chill at home tonight.

Not much, just chilling on the sofa.
Nothing really — I’m chilling on the couch.

tasks.say: Я цілими днями чилю на пляжі й читаю.
ans: I chill on the beach and read all day.
I’m chilling on the beach all day and reading.
Just chilling on the beach and reading all day long.

near: trust*|buy it|fall for|fell for|swallow*|take* it at face value|accept*

tasks.sit: Твоя бабуся переслала тобі в месенджері новину про «чудо-ліки від усього».
tasks.say: Бабусю, не вір сліпо всьому, що пишуть в інтернеті.
ans: Grandma, don’t blindly believe everything you read online.
Grandma, you shouldn’t blindly believe everything on the internet.
Grandma, please don’t blindly believe whatever you see online.

tasks.sit: На лекції з критичного мислення викладач пояснює, як розпізнати маніпуляції.

ans: People often blindly believe in leaders without checking the facts.
People tend to believe blindly in their leaders and never check the facts.
A lot of people believe blindly in leaders — they don’t check facts.

tasks.sit: Подруга розповідає, що вклала всі заощадження за порадою знайомого «інвестора».

ans: You can’t blindly believe someone you’ve known for two weeks.
You shouldn’t believe blindly in a guy you’ve only known for two weeks.
You can’t just blindly believe someone you met two weeks ago.

tasks.sit: Сусід дивується, що твій собака так швидко вивчив нові команди.

ans: I clicker-trained him — it works really fast.
I’ve been clicker-training him, and it works super quickly.
I clicker-trained him, honestly it works so fast.

ans: Yes, you can clicker-train cats too; it just takes patience.
Yes, cats can be clicker-trained too — you just need patience.
Totally, you can clicker-train cats too, just be patient.

I want to clicker-train my puppy rather than yell at it.
